# **SanDisk (SNDKB) 8-for-1 Stock Split on Mudrex: Schedule and Impact on SNDKB Holdings**


SanDisk Corporation (SNDK) is undergoing an 8-for-1 forward stock split. As part of this corporate action, Mudrex will support the adjustment for users holding SNDKB.


For every 1 SNDKB unit held before the split, eligible holders will receive 7 additional units, bringing their total holding to 8 units. The price per unit will adjust to approximately one-eighth of its pre-split level. This means the total value of your holding will remain unchanged due to the split itself.


To support the adjustment, SNDKB trading, deposits, and withdrawals will be temporarily paused on Mudrex on 19 November. Here is what you need to know about the split, the schedule, and how it will affect your holdings and open orders.


## **What Is a Stock Split?**


A stock split is a corporate action in which a company increases the number of units of its stock by dividing each existing unit into multiple units.


For example, in an 8-for-1 stock split, every 1 existing unit becomes 8 units. The price per unit is reduced in the same proportion. So, while the quantity you hold increases, the price of each unit decreases.


A stock split does not increase or reduce the overall value of your holding by itself. It only changes the number of units and the price per unit.


## **What Is Happening to SanDisk (SNDK) and SNDKB?**


SanDisk Corporation (SNDK) is carrying out an 8-for-1 forward stock split.


If you hold SNDKB when the split is applied, your quantity will increase eightfold. You will receive 7 additional SNDKB units for every 1 unit you held before the split.


At the same time, the price per unit will adjust to approximately one-eighth of its pre-split price. Your average buy price will also be adjusted in the same proportion.


The split does not change the total value of your holding. The increase in quantity is balanced by the reduction in the price per unit.


## **SNDKB Stock Split: Important Dates and Timings**


Mudrex will temporarily pause SNDKB trading to process the stock split.

During this period:


- Buying and selling SNDKB will be disabled on the Mudrex app and web platform.


- All open SNDKB orders will be cancelled by the system at 06:00 PM IST on 19th November.


- Trading will resume on or before 21st November.


You can use Mudrex again for SNDKB trading once trading resumes.


## **What Happens to Your SNDKB Holdings After the Split?**


Your SNDKB holdings will be adjusted automatically as part of the stock split. You do not need to place a request or take any action.


Once the adjustment is complete, you will see the following changes on Mudrex:


1. **Updated holding quantity**


Your SNDKB quantity will increase eightfold. For every 1 unit held before the split, you will receive 7 additional units.


1. **Adjusted average buy price**


Your average buy price will reduce to one-eighth of its previous value, in line with the split ratio.


1. **Updated chart price**


The SNDKB chart will reflect the adjusted price after the split. The lower price per unit is a result of the stock split and does not, by itself, indicate a loss in the value of your holding.


1. **Transaction history**


The stock split will appear as two separate transactions in your transaction history: a sell transaction followed by a buy transaction.


Both transactions will have the same transaction amount and will be executed without any fees or TDS.


The sell transaction will be executed at the average buy price of your existing holdings. This ensures that the stock split adjustment does not result in any realised returns.


For example, if you held 2 SNDKB before an 8-for-1 split, your transaction history will show:


- Sell: 2 SNDKB at $1,200 per unit


- Buy: 16 SNDKB at $150 per unit


Both transactions will have a transaction amount of $2,400.


Your transaction history entries recorded before the split will remain unchanged.

## **What Happens to Your Open SNDKB Orders?**


All open SNDKB orders on Mudrex will be automatically cancelled when trading is paused on 19 November.


These orders will not be restored after trading resumes. If you want to place them again, you will need to create new orders once SNDKB trading is available.


Here is what happens to your orders and blocked funds:


- Cancelled orders will appear in your order history with the status


**Cancelled** .


- Funds blocked for cancelled buy orders will be released immediately.


- SNDKB units blocked for cancelled sell orders will also be released immediately.


- Users whose orders are cancelled will receive a notification.


Make sure to review your orders and place new ones after trading resumes, if required.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


1. **Will I lose money because of the SNDKB stock split?**


No. The stock split itself does not reduce the total value of your holding. Your SNDKB quantity increases eight times, while the price per unit and average buy price adjust to one-eighth of their previous levels. The overall value remains the same due to the split, although market prices can change after trading resumes.


1. **Why did the price of SNDKB drop so much?**


The price per unit adjusts as part of the 8-for-1 stock split. After the split, each SNDKB unit is expected to trade at approximately one-eighth of its pre-split price. This adjustment is not, by itself, a market loss.


1. **Why did my SNDKB quantity change?**


Your quantity increased because of the 8-for-1 stock split. You receive 7 additional units for every 1 SNDKB unit you held before the split. For example, 2 units become 16 units.


1. **What happened to my open SNDKB order?**


All open SNDKB orders are automatically cancelled when trading is paused on 19th November. They will not be restored after trading resumes.


1. **Do I need to do anything to receive the additional SNDKB units?**


No. The stock split adjustment will be applied automatically to eligible SNDKB holdings. Your quantity and average buy price will be updated, and the adjustment will appear in your transaction history.


1. **When can I trade SNDKB again?**


SNDKB trading on Mudrex will resume on or before 21st November. Buying and selling will be disabled from 19th Nov until trading resumes.


## **Important Note**


This blog is for informational purposes only and explains the SNDKB stock split and its impact on holdings and trading activity on Mudrex. It does not constitute investment advice or a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold SNDKB.


Stock prices can change due to market conditions. The stock split does not protect your holdings from market-related price movements or potential losses. Always consider your financial situation and risk tolerance before making trading decisions.
